At the London premiere of Wuthering Heights, she wore a bracelet.
lines.say: At the London premiere of Wuthering Heights, she wore a bracelet.

lines.text: It copied a Victorian hair bracelet that belonged to Charlotte Brontë.
The original is kept in the Brontë Parsonage Museum in Haworth.
It is woven from hair believed to be Emily's and Anne's.
The museum pointed her stylist to Wyedean Weaving, a Haworth firm.
Real hair was ruled out, so the copy is braided thread.
They braided it on a hundred-year-old machine, in a rare diagonal plait.
The original shifts color in different light, so they ran twelve trials.
The copy used 250,000 meters of thread.

post.caption: Margot Robbie's Brontë bracelet isn't hair. At the London premiere of Wuthering Heights, she wore a bracelet. It copied a Victorian hair bracelet that belonged to Charlotte Brontë. Real hair was ruled out, so the copy is braided thread. They braided it on a hundred-year-old machine, in a rare diagonal plait. The original shifts color in different light, so they ran twelve trials. The copy used 250,000 meters of thread.
